subject: How to show a column option and get a different column in selectInput?

messages.author: c2b5e51822713170
messages.subject: How to show a column option and get a different column in selectInput?
parts:
I would like to show a list of choices in character type but return an ID column in numeric type when the user chose. How can I do that? The input$[value] returned is always the options showed in the list.

Thank you!

messages.author: 266719e6c4f9a177
messages.subject: Re: How to show a column option and get a different column in selectInput?
parts: lets say the choices that you are providing are a,b and c and you want to assign them IDs x,y,z then in the selectInput write choices as x="a",y="b",z="c" and it will give u the id instead of value
